rules.OF590_00221_AFA_LT15: ID retained; proceed_with_caution → consultant_review with explicit NCCP/EMA conflict; numeric CrCl/eGFR and dialysis flags added without converting between measures.
rules.OF590_00221_AFA_CHILD_C: ID retained; proceed_with_caution → consultant_review because NCCP no adjustment expected conflicts with EMA not recommended.
rules.ECOG_OUTSIDE_USUAL_RANGE: Removed: afatinib NCCP v5 does not specify a numerical ECOG eligibility threshold. Existing ECOG input retained.
rules.TARGET_PNEUMONITIS_G2: Replaced by ILD_SUSPECTED (any grade≥1 or suspicion holds) and ILD_CONFIRMED (confirmation permanently stops); grade alone no longer permanently stops.
rules.TARGET_HEPATITIS: Removed unsupported universal ALT/AST >5×ULN hold; LIVER_RESULTS_CONTEXT reviews abnormal values without assumed causality, SEVERE_LFT_HOLD uses clinically confirmed severe event.

rules.OF590_00565_DACO_RENAL_SEV: ID retained; consultant_review retained; SmPC CrCl<30 and dialysis added as independent triggers, numeric dose explicitly blocked.
rules.OF590_00565_DACO_CHILD_C: ID retained; dose_reduce → consultant_review when initiation/current-dose context is unknown. Message retains starting30mg and optional≥4-week escalation. New DACO_CHILD_C_START requires explicit treatment_start and carries30mg into dose table. Concurrent blocking review suppresses it.
rules.ECOG_OUTSIDE_USUAL_RANGE: Threshold corrected from >2 to >1 because NCCP requires ECOG0–1.
rules.TARGET_PNEUMONITIS_G2: Replaced by ILD_SUSPECTED and ILD_CONFIRMED as above; same source-specific approach at any grade.
rules.TARGET_HEPATITIS: Replaced by clinical context/confirmed-severe event pathways; NCCP does not provide universal numeric5×ULN threshold.
rules.PREGNANCY_BREASTFEEDING: SmPC clinical precaution, not NCCP absolute listed exclusion; consultant_review with numeric-dose block.
